title: Approximating Softmax in Pretrained LLMs: Model Sensitivity and Kernel Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2609.33586v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On NVIDIA Blackwell B200, tensor-core throughput outpaces special-function exponential throughput by more than two orders of magnitude, exposing exponential evaluation in fused attention kernels. A pretrained Transformer, however, may not need it evaluated accurately at every element. We characterize what a pretrained model does need by approximating softmax at inference in ten frozen decoder-only models (0.5B-72B). The number of positions the softmax map assigns probability to and within-row resolution can be cut substantially, yet uniform weighting of the same positions is damaging. Where a fixed resolution budget is placed matters as much as its size, with resolution near the row maximum consistently favored. Perturbations matched on scalar distortion produce model-dependent responses of opposite sign. translated_title: 在预训练大语言模型中近似Softmax：模型敏感性与内核加速
translated_abstract: 在NVIDIA Blackwell B200上，张量核心的吞吐量比特殊函数（指数运算）的吞吐量高出两个数量级以上，这使得融合注意力内核中的指数求值成为性能瓶颈。然而，预训练的Transformer可能并不需要在每个元素上都精确计算指数。我们通过在十个冻结的仅解码器模型（0.5B-72B）上进行推理时的softmax近似，刻画了预训练模型实际需要的精度。softmax映射分配概率的位置数量以及行内分辨率都可以大幅削减，但对相同位置进行均匀加权则是有害的。固定分辨率预算放置的位置与其大小同样重要，靠近行最大值处的分辨率始终更受青睐。在标量失真上匹配的扰动会产生符号相反的、依赖于模型的响应。这些发现促使我们提出了Rowmax-PoT——一种以每行最大值为锚点的粗对数权重表示，以及Rowmax-H15，其……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究系统刻画了预训练大模型对softmax近似的敏感性，并提出以行最大值为锚点的粗对数权重表示Rowmax-PoT，从而大幅削减注意力内核中的指数运算开销、缓解张量核心与特殊函数吞吐量的巨大差距。
en_tdlr: This work characterizes pretrained LLMs' sensitivity to softmax approximation and proposes Rowmax-PoT, a coarse logarithmic weight representation anchored at each row maximum, enabling substantial reduction of exponential evaluation cost in fused attention kernels.
